name: Deploy to Development
description: Deploy one already-verified commit to development: load the verified release evidence, stop for its own explicit approval, deploy, independently verify (roll back on failure), and report. Started only on an explicit deploy request; never chained from Development or Deploy to Production.
kickoff:
Start the "Deploy to Development" loop.
Goal: the approved, verified commit runs on development with fresh health evidence.
Max iterations: 1
Exit when: the development deployment was separately approved, deployed, verified (or rolled back) and reported.
Guardrails (do not skip):
- Never deploy without this workflow's own approval
- Never start Deploy to Production from this workflow

loop_contract.name: Deploy to Development
loop_contract.goal: approved verified commit deployed to development with fresh verification evidence
loop_contract.exit_when: development deployment approved in this run, deployed, verified or rolled back, and reported
loop_contract.check_command: configured development health check and smoke journey
guardrails: Do not skip, disable, or bypass the deployment approval gate
Execute only the exact approved commit, target and commands
Never start Deploy to Production from this workflow

expected_check_command: configured development health check and smoke journey pass

steps.name: Load verified release evidence for development
steps.instruction: Read the linked ticket's latest Development result packet and completion manifest, the current repository state, and the maintained deployment configuration for the development environment (target, deploy command, health check, smoke journey, rollback command). Confirm the exact commit was independently verified. If there is no passing verification evidence, fail and recommend running Development first. Read the project's saved Plan (Interfaces, Data, Documents) for the user journeys the smoke check must cover. Do not deploy, push, or change any runtime environment in this step, and never start Deploy to Production from this workflow.
steps.guardrail:
- Read-only: do not deploy, push, restart services, or edit project files
- Never infer deployment targets, commands, credentials, health checks, or rollback behavior
- Fail closed when verification evidence or deployment configuration is missing
failure_checklist: No passing verification evidence for an exact commit
Deployment target, command, health check or rollback is missing
The step changed a runtime environment
steps.validation_prompt: A release evidence packet names one exact verified commit and the maintained development target, deploy command, health check, smoke journey and rollback command; nothing was deployed.
steps.other_tool: Ticket result packet, repository state, maintained deployment configuration, saved Plan

steps.name: Development deployment approval
steps.instruction: Freeze the independently verified release before any deployment. Remove or explicitly inventory generated workflow artifacts, confirm the real diff matches the completion manifest, create the release commit, and push that exact commit only when the ticket authorizes release delivery. Resolve the development target, deploy command, health check, smoke journey, and rollback command from maintained project configuration. Never invent a target or command. Return a compact approval packet containing the exact commit, files changed, test and browser evidence, development target, deploy command, health check, and rollback command. If any field is missing, fail without deploying. This step prepares evidence only and must not change a runtime environment. Then stop and wait for Paul's explicit approval of this development deployment. This approval belongs to this workflow only; an approval given to any other run or workflow does not count.
steps.guardrail:
- Stay on the linked ticket scope; avoid unrelated refactors or scope creep
- Prefer minimal diffs, explicit evidence, and reversible changes
- Do not deploy in this step
- Never infer deployment targets, commands, credentials, health checks, or rollback behavior
- Approval evidence must describe the exact immutable commit and current verified checks
failure_checklist: Release commit or changed-file inventory does not match the completion manifest
Development target, deploy command, health check, smoke journey, or rollback command is missing
Approval packet omits current test or browser evidence
A runtime environment was changed before approval
steps.validation_prompt: A complete development deployment approval packet exists for one exact verified commit and no deployment has occurred.

steps.name: Deploy approved commit to development
steps.instruction: Deploy only the exact commit approved in the preceding decision to the configured development target. Verify the target before execution, run the maintained deploy command, start or restart only the configured development service, then run the configured health check and smoke journey. If the commit, target, command, approval, or environment state differs from the approval packet, stop without deploying. On any failed health or smoke check, run the configured rollback command and report both the failure and rollback evidence. Never touch production in this step.
steps.guardrail:
- Stay on the linked ticket scope; avoid unrelated refactors or scope creep
- Prefer minimal diffs, explicit evidence, and reversible changes
- Execute only the exact approved commit, target, and commands
- Fail closed when approval evidence or maintained deployment configuration is absent
- Roll back on failed development health or smoke verification
- Never access the production target in this step
failure_checklist: Deployment ran without the recorded human approval
Deployed commit or target differs from the approval packet
Development health check or smoke journey is missing or failed
A failed deployment was not rolled back with evidence
steps.validation_prompt: The approved commit is running on development, configured health and smoke checks pass, and rollback evidence exists for any failed attempt.

steps.name: Independently verify the development deployment
steps.instruction: From a fresh session, independently verify the development deployment: confirm the running commit equals the approved commit, run the configured health check and the smoke journey, and check for console or server errors. If any check fails, run the configured rollback command, verify the rollback, and fail this step with both pieces of evidence. Never touch production.
steps.guardrail:
- Verify only; do not redeploy or change code
- Roll back on failed health or journey verification
- Never access the production target
failure_checklist: Running commit differs from the approved commit
Health or journey check failed without rollback
steps.validation_prompt: Fresh development health and journey evidence for the approved commit, or verified rollback evidence on failure.

steps.name: Report the development deployment and compact memory
steps.instruction: Return a compact result packet for the ticket: the deployed commit, development deploy, health and journey evidence, rollback evidence if any, remaining risks and next actions. Deploy to Production is a separate workflow with its own approval; do not start, request, or schedule it. This is a reporting transformation: do not re-run checks or edit project files. Write only durable memory deltas (deploy commands, targets, health checks, failures, lessons). Return the exact named fields ticket_result_packet, compact_memory_delta, failed_attempts, and lessons in the response.
steps.guardrail:
- Stay on the linked ticket scope; avoid unrelated refactors or scope creep
- Prefer minimal diffs, explicit evidence, and reversible changes
- Do not paste full transcripts into memory; compact durable facts only
- Ticket result must be usable by the next run without reading the full chat
- Do not re-run validation or inspect evidence; summarize the accepted upstream result
- Do not create or edit project files during reporting; return the packet in the model response only
failure_checklist: Changed files or commands are missing
Evidence or N/A reason is missing
Memory delta contains transcript noise instead of durable facts
steps.validation_prompt: Ticket contains summary, evidence, commands, changed files, risks/blockers, next actions, and compact memory deltas for future runs.
steps.other_tool: Ticket update, result packet, and compact workspace memory
